lines.text: Why do your earbuds still play in airplane mode?
On iPhone, airplane mode turns off cellular and Wi-Fi.
But Bluetooth is the one radio it leaves on.
So earbuds and watches stay connected.
If the airline allows it, turn Wi-Fi back on.
Turn Bluetooth off there once, and it stays off next time.

post.title: Why do your earbuds still play in airplane mode?
post.caption:
Why do your earbuds still play in airplane mode? ✈️

On iPhone, airplane mode turns off cellular and Wi-Fi, but it leaves Bluetooth on. That's why your earbuds and your watch stay connected on a flight. If the airline allows it, you can turn Wi-Fi back on yourself from Control Center while airplane mode stays on. And your iPhone remembers: turn Bluetooth off while you're in airplane mode, and it stays off the next time you switch airplane mode on.
Send this to the friend who takes their earbuds out on every flight.
